query:
SELECT id, name FROM molecules 
WHERE wikidata_qid IS NULL 
AND name IS NOT NULL
AND name NOT REGEXP '^(Test|Terre|Fumée|Résine|traces|profil|aldéhyde)'
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 10;
